text:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up from the morning blip — we saw a spike of partial responses and handshake timeouts on the streaming chat endpoint.
sam: saw it too. clients reported truncation then eventual reconnects. collecting traces now.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-streaming-blip. Initial severity: P2.
maria: timeline & quick notes: 09:12 reduced throughput -> 09:14 partial chunks for ~43 sessions -> 09:20 fallback to polling increased. No deploys at the time.
kai: hypothesis: KV cache eviction thundering combined with a burst of long-context requests. attaching sample query distribution.
alex: action list I'm proposing (short):
  1) short-term client handshake backoff tweak (owner: sam) — verify 5s->10s -> can rollback. target: 2026-04-23
  2) server-side partial-chunk detection alert (owner: maria) — threshold & PagerDuty. target: 2026-04-25
  3) investigate KV eviction pattern + repro (owner: kai) — reproduce with burst load generator & save heap profiles. target: 2026-04-30
  4) add Canary route with reduced batch size for long-context customers (owner: alex) — rollout plan + metrics. target: 2026-05-05
sam: I'll own #1. quick test plan: bump handshake timeout & backoff in clients for vip tier, monitor error-rate and reconnection latency for 24h.
  - test command we can run in staging: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"stream":true,"max_tokens":4096}' https://staging.api.redwood/chat/stream
maria: for #2 I'll add an SLO alert: if partial-response-rate > 0.4% over 10m -> P1 page to eng-sre. also create a dashboard tile for partial chunk ratio.
kai: for reproducer: I'll run a generator that opens 300 concurrent streams with varying prefix lengths, force KV churn. paste of the generator config:
```
clients: 300
pattern: mix(short:70%, long:30%)
interval: poisson(0.8s)
kv_ops: churn-heavy
```
alex: also want a recurrence check: scan incidents last 90 days for 'partial'/'timeout' signatures and group by root cause. can someone own that analysis? helps decide infra vs client fix.
maria: I can run the 90d scan and produce a short doc with common patterns and owners. target: 2026-04-29
sam: small wins: enable short-term retry window on gateway (2 extra attempts with exponential backoff), reduces user-visible truncation in our internal tests.
kai: note: if we increase retries aggressively we might accidentally load spike our backend. tests must measure backend queueing latency.
alex: agree. let's gate retries behind circuit-breaker that watches CPU and queue depth.
incident-bot: Action items updated: #1 sam assigned, #2 maria assigned, #3 kai assigned, #4 alex assigned.
sam: check-in: I'll push client backoff patch to staging by EOD and tag this thread with results.
maria: I'll post the 90d scan doc in #incidents and link here when done.
kai: will share repro logs and perf profiles in the runbook channel.
alex: thanks all. Next sync Friday 10:00am PT to confirm rollouts or revert plans. If anyone sees a regression before then, ping @sam and @maria immediately.
sam: :thumbsup:
maria: :+1:
kai: logging steps and starting repro now.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status -> monitoring.
